activities.description: The Interrogator asks Mr. Shepherd if he knows what he will say next.
Mr. Shepherd remains silent. The Interrogator tells him he's free to go.
Mr. Shepherd laughs, then says, "That's funny. That's funny." The Interrogator looks confused.
Mr. Shepherd apologizes, saying, "Should've seen that coming."
The Interrogator stands up to leave, then stops and asks, "What about those cuffs? Did you see those coming?"

activities.description: Mr. Shepherd, now handcuffed to the table, says, "Eventually."
Mr. Shepherd says, "I knew you wouldn't give up. Not after what happened with Aiden Stenner."
The Interrogator stares at him, visibly affected by his words. Mr. Shepherd adds, "But you probably don't want to talk about that."
